name: anthony-vineyards
description: Beta scope for Anthony Vineyards. Selects the workflows whose segments include one of the customer's and whose required modules are all within the enabled set.

excluded.Onboarding: A13 parked for Anthony (employee onboarding forms)
excluded.Signature: A13 parked for Anthony; also excludes the signed acknowledgement in B12/C9
excluded.H2A: E12 parked for Anthony (H2A module off)
excluded.Cost Accounting: F3 parked for Anthony (cost-versus-price analysis off)
excluded.Field Printer: B13 field receipt printing — catalog notes it is rarely used in practice
excluded.Packing: pack-house only; outside the grower / perennial-grower segments
excluded.Pallet Tracking: pack-house only; catalog notes case-to-pallet is not a closed link yet
excluded.Picture Verification: kiosk photo fallback; pack-house / nursery only

notes: confirmed=false — this is derived from the catalog's Anthony notes, not from a signed module list. Confirm the enabled modules with the account before treating a skip here as authoritative.
The catalog states Anthony uses departments even within a single state, so Department is enabled.
Set TEST_SCOPE=anthony-vineyards to apply this scope; leave it unset to run every workflow.
